question.knowledge_point: Determining Whether a Vector Lies on a Plane
question.problem: Determine if the vector $u$ lies on the plane $Π:r=sb+tc$, $t,s\in R$, where  $b=⟨1,2,3⟩$, $c=⟨3,8,-7⟩$, and  $u=⟨9,22,-5⟩.$ In the affirmative case, find the value of $s\cdot t$ from the decomposition $u=sb+tc.$
question.worked_solution:
By definition, $u\in Π$ if there exist $t$ and $s$ such that

$$
\begin{aligned}sb+tc & =u \\ s[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ 3\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 8 \\ -7\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}9 \\ 22 \\ -5\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the following system of equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}s+3t=9 \\ 2s+8t=22 \\ 3s-7t=-5\end{aligned}
$$

To solve the system above, we set up and row reduce an augmented matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 9 \\ 2 & 8 & 22 \\ 3 & -7 & -5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 9 \\ 0 & 2 & 4 \\ 3 & -7 & -5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 9 \\ 0 & 2 & 4 \\ 0 & -16 & -32\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+8{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 & 9 \\ 0 & 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}s+3t=9 \\ 2t=4 \\ 0=0.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second equation, we get

$$
2t=4\,⟹\,t=2.
$$

Substituting into the first equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}s+3t & =9 \\ s+3(2) & =9 \\ s & =3.\end{aligned}
$$

Since we found a solution $s=3,\,t=2,$ we conclude that $u$ does indeed lie on the plane $Π.$ In fact, we have

$$
u=3b+2c.
$$

Finally, $s\cdot t=3\cdot 2=6.$
